prompts.name: mri
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production desktop icon PNG. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not the subject. Create a compact MRI scanner: pale grey square scanner body with a large black circular bore and short patient-free table extending toward the viewer; tiny periwinkle control panel. Match the reference's early-1990s Macintosh System 7 pixel artwork family: hard stepped charcoal outlines, pale grey and white faces, muted periwinkle blue and tiny ochre accents, top-left highlight, shallow lower-right grey edge and very small hard shadow. Logical 32px grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels, extremely simple recognizable silhouette readable at 32px. Centered subject fills 85 percent of a square canvas. Deliver genuine transparent RGBA alpha outside the icon, NO painted checkerboard, NO solid background, NO label, letters, branding, watermark, app tile, glossy modern emoji shading, gradients or soft shadow. Exactly one icon.
